author: Uyzi-1
title: Mouse click highlight feature running issues in some programs
summary: The reporter’s screenshots show a green click-highlight ring over Visual Studio Installer and, after clicking “View,” an IME candidate strip. They do not show the transition or identify which of the two named PowerToys areas/modes produced the ring.

status.label: Needs targeted evidence
status.detail: The static screenshots and older build do not establish which feature/mode is stuck or whether it reproduces on current PowerToys.

next_action.label: Confirm Mouse Highlighter mode and capture the click sequence
next_action.reason: A short recording and mode/version confirmation distinguish a stuck transient click effect from an always-on mode or a separate overlay.

judgment.rationale: The public screenshots establish a green ring in Visual Studio Installer, but they do not establish that a Mouse Highlighter click animation has frozen: the issue names both Mouse Without Borders and Mouse Utilities, and the follow-up screenshot contains an IME candidate strip. The report is on 0.101.2362, so current-version reproduction also matters.
evidence: The issue body reports PowerToys 0.101.2362 on Windows 10 22H2 and names Visual Studio Installer Community 18.10.3.
The primary screenshot shows a green ring over the Visual Studio Installer’s “Debugging and testing” area.
The follow-up screenshot after clicking “View” shows an input-method candidate popup; neither screenshot records whether the ring fades, follows the pointer, or persists after disabling the feature.
The report lists both Mouse Without Borders and Mouse Utilities but does not name the specific feature or mode.
A PowerToys report ZIP is attached, but its private contents are not repeated in this artifact; no matching upstream PR or MuyuanMS/PowerToys trace was found.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for the exact feature/mode plus a short recording of activation, click, wait, and pointer movement, and confirm whether it reproduces on the latest stable version.

fix_assessment.rationale: The fast-pass evidence does not yet isolate a PowerToys defect or owning feature/mode; a code fix is not applicable to propose until the requested behavior is distinguished from the static screenshot and checked on a current build.

issue_context.summary: A green circular highlight is visible over Visual Studio Installer, but the current screenshots do not prove that a click animation is frozen or identify the PowerToys feature/mode involved.
known_information: The reported PowerToys version is 0.101.2362, the installation source is GitHub, and the OS is Windows 10 22H2.
The body lists Mouse Without Borders and Mouse Utilities and names Visual Studio Installer Community 18.10.3.
The primary screenshot shows a green circle over “Debugging and testing”; the comment screenshot shows IME candidate suggestions after clicking “View.”
A PowerToysReport ZIP is attached; this candidate does not reproduce or quote its private contents.
The issue lists additional installed software, but the screenshots do not establish which program produces the visible ring.
inferences: The ring may be Mouse Highlighter output, but the issue does not identify the exact feature or settings and the screenshot alone cannot show a frozen animation.
The second screenshot’s IME candidate strip may be separate from the ring; a recording and off/on comparison would distinguish them.
Because the reported build is 0.101.2362, the defect may differ in current main; the issue has not confirmed current stable reproduction.
issue_context.analysis: Current Mouse Highlighter code has an explicit button-up path that fades click indicators, while the reported static images omit timing and mode. The evidence supports a narrowly targeted clarification rather than a speculative code change or broad request for logs.
initial_investigation: Read the full public issue body and only comment, and visually inspected both attached screenshots; the body screenshot contains a green ring over the installer UI and the comment screenshot contains an IME candidate strip.
Checked upstream source at microsoft/PowerToys main commit 1b33221dfa19f30d71409eb550807883fb27283a.

src/modules/MouseUtils/MouseHighlighter/MouseHighlighter.cpp queues low-level mouse button events; its LeftButtonUp/RightButtonUp handling fades legacy indicators or fades the ripple hold dot, while quick clicks emit a finite ripple. This does not prove which mode/version the reporter used.
No upstream PR or matching MuyuanMS/PowerToys issue/PR trace was found for #51175.
The attached private diagnostic ZIP was not unpacked; no raw diagnostic contents are included.

Rechecked both screenshots and the View follow-up: a static ring cannot establish fade duration or the owning utility. Preserve the exact-feature/mode and short activation/click/wait recording request; no additional ZIP ask.

information_gaps.information: Which PowerToys feature is producing the ring (Mouse Highlighter or Mouse Without Borders) and, if Mouse Highlighter, whether Ripple, Spotlight, or always-on highlighting is enabled and whether the ring persists after toggling the feature off.
information_gaps.why_needed: The issue names two areas and the configured mode determines whether a persistent ring is expected or a transient click effect failed to fade.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with the exact feature and visible Mouse Highlighter mode/settings, then toggle that feature off and confirm whether the ring disappears.

information_gaps.information: A short recording showing activation, clicking the Visual Studio Installer search result, the next two seconds, and whether the ring fades or follows the pointer; note whether the IME candidate popup appears with the feature off.
information_gaps.why_needed: The still images cannot establish timing or distinguish a frozen click indicator from a separate UI/IME overlay.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Record the sequence and upload the clip using GitHub’s web UI; redact unrelated personal content.

information_gaps.information: Whether the same sequence still reproduces on the latest stable PowerToys release, with its exact version.
information_gaps.why_needed: The report is on 0.101.2362, so this determines whether current main still needs investigation.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Retest on the latest stable build and reply with the exact version shown in PowerToys About and whether the ring persists.

actions.label: Confirm the highlight mode and capture the click behavior

comment.body:
Thanks for providing the PowerToys/Windows versions, naming Visual Studio Installer, and attaching screenshots. The first image shows a green ring over the installer; the follow-up shows an IME candidate strip after clicking “View.” Those still images do not show whether the ring fades or follows the pointer, and the report names both Mouse Without Borders and Mouse Utilities.

**Needed**
1. Please confirm which PowerToys feature produces the ring. If it is Mouse Highlighter, state whether Ripple, Spotlight, or always-on highlighting is enabled, and whether the ring disappears when you toggle the feature off.
2. Could you upload a short recording through GitHub’s web UI showing activation, the click on the Visual Studio Installer result, and the next two seconds while the pointer is idle/moving? Please note whether the IME candidate strip also appears with the feature off.
3. Please confirm whether the same sequence reproduces on the latest stable PowerToys release and give its exact version.

This will distinguish a click indicator that fails to fade from a persistent display mode or a separate overlay, and show whether the older 0.101.2362 behavior still affects current builds.
